# Lamp Builder 1.1.0
- Automatic checks for new versions, with a choice to install when you are ready. - Check for Updates and an automatic-check preference in the Lamp Builder menu, available from Home and project windows. - Developer ID signing and Apple notarization for public downloads.
Your lamp designs, collections, and purchase receipts stay in their existing locations.
Requires an Apple silicon Mac running macOS 15 or later. Existing 1.0.0 installations need this DMG once to gain in-app updates.
